review_candidates.title: Vice President of Finance and Operations
review_candidates.description: About The Myelodysplastic Syndromes Foundation The Myelodysplastic Syndromes (MDS) Foundation is the global nonprofit leader dedicated to improving the lives of patients and families affected by MDS through patient support, education, research, advocacy, and strategic collaboration. We serve as a trusted resource for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, researchers, and industry partners worldwide while working to accelerate better outcomes and, ultimately, cures. Position Overview The Vice President of Finance and Operations leads the MDS Foundation's financial strategy and core operational functions, ensuring sound financial stewardship, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and the infrastructure needed to support informed decision-making, organizational transparency, and long-term sustainability. As a key member of the senior leadership team, the Vice President serves as a strategic partner to the CEO and Board of Directors during an important phase of organizational growth. The role provides executive oversight of financial planning and analysis, budgeting, reporting, audit, compliance, and operational systems, while developing the scalable processes, controls, and infrastructure necessary to support the Foundation's mission and long-term strategic priorities. The Vice President will ensure the Foundation's financial and operational data are translated into meaningful insights that support strategic planning, organizational performance, and decision-making. The ideal candidate is an entrepreneurial, strategic builder who thrives in a dynamic, mission-driven environment, combining big-picture vision with a hands-on approach to execution. They will strengthen the Foundation's financial and operational capabilities by driving continuous improvement, enhancing organizational effectiveness, and building the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth and greater mission impact. Key Responsibilities Financial Strategy Lead the Foundation's financial strategy by developing long-term financial plans, projections, scenario analyses, and cash-flow models that support organizational sustainability, liquidity, and growth. Serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and Board of Directors, providing financial analysis, modeling, and insights to inform organizational decisions. Develop meaningful financial and operational performance metrics that support organizational accountability and continuous improvement. Budgeting, Forecasting, and Financial Planning Lead development and oversight of the annual budget and multi-year financial plans. Design and implement best-in-class budgeting and forecasting processes, transitioning from legacy or ad hoc approaches to more rigorous, forward-looking planning. Monitor financial performance through forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning, proactively identifying risks and opportunities. Financial Reporting, Transparency, and Controls Build financial reporting frameworks and dashboards to improve visibility, decision-making, and organizational accountability. Prepare and present financial materials for Board and Finance/Audit Committee meetings; serve as financial expert at those meetings. Strengthen financial controls by assessing existing accounting practices and implementing robust internal controls, policies, and documentation to safeguard organizational assets. Accounting, Audit, and Compliance Provide executive oversight of all accounting functions, including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, payroll accounting, and month-end and year-end close. Ensure compliance with GAAP, IRS regulations, nonprofit accounting standards, and all applicable federal and state requirements. Serve as primary liaison to external auditors and oversee the annual audit, Form 990 preparation, and other tax filings. Operational Excellence Assess and strengthen accounting infrastructure and close processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Lead the Foundation's payroll and benefits administration through effective management of the PEO relationship, ensuring compliance, accuracy, and an exceptional employee experience. Provide financial and operational oversight of employee benefits, including health, retirement, and related programs, in partnership with external vendors. Grants, Restricted Funds, and Financial Stewardship Oversee financial management of restricted and unrestricted funds, ensuring compliance with donor and grant requirements. Partner with Development and Partnerships teams on budgeting, reconciliation, and financial reporting. Strengthen financial tracking and reporting capabilities for restricted funding to support growth in complex, multi-year funding streams. Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner across the organization to ensure financial considerations are integrated into strategic planning, operational decisions, and organizational growth initiatives. Lead organizational change by fostering a culture of accountability, financial stewardship, operational excellence, and shared responsibility. Operate with a ‘roll-up-your-sleeves’ mindset, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution when needed. Qualifications & Experience Required / Preferred Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field required; CPA, MBA, or advanced degree preferred 10+ years of progressive financial leadership experience, including senior-level responsibility Experience in nonprofit finance strongly preferred; familiarity with restricted funds and grant accounting required Proven success building or strengthening financial and operational infrastructure within a growing organization strongly preferred Experience overseeing payroll, benefits, and PEO relationships preferred Demonstrated experience presenting financial information to Boards and executive leadership Skills & Competencies Strong financial and strategic acumen, with the ability to translate data into insights that drive decision-making, growth, and mission impact Deep knowledge of GAAP, nonprofit accounting standards, and compliance requirements Highly analytical with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to identify issues and implement practical, scalable solutions Ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to non-financial audiences High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail Collaborative leadership style with a calm, solutions-oriented approach Experience driving change, improving processes, and leading through organizational growth Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and execute across multiple initiatives Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment Compensation We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed compensation package that reflects the importance of this role and supports our team's well-being, flexibility, and long-term success: Competitive annual salary of $120,000–$150,000, commensurate with experience Comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage 401(k) with employer match to support long-term financial planning Flexible paid time off (PTO) policy that encourages rest and recharge Generous holiday schedule, including organizational closures around major holidays Flexible/remote work environment, with a focus on outcomes and work-life balance Why Join The MDS Foundation This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of a growing global organization dedicated to improving the lives of people affected by MDS. As a member of the senior leadership team, the Vice President of Finance and Operations will play a central role in strengthening the Foundation's financial and operational infrastructure, enabling smarter data-driven decisions, supporting strong governance, and building the organizational capacity needed to expand our impact for patients, caregivers, healthcare professionals, and researchers worldwide.

Moderna’s culture values agility, accountability, and continuous learning, providing team members with opportunities to tackle complex challenges and drive meaningful change in global health. Joining Moderna means contributing to a mission-driven organization that is shaping the future of medicine and operating at the intersection of science, technology, and patient care. Role Description The Vice President Operations at Moderna US is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading end-to-end operational strategy and execution across key business functions. This position oversees operational performance, resource allocation, and process optimization to support scalability, efficiency, and quality in a fast-paced biotech environment. Day-to-day responsibilities include setting operational priorities, driving cross-functional alignment, managing budgets and P&L, and ensuring that service levels meet internal and external stakeholder expectations. The role also involves leading major operational initiatives and projects, monitoring key performance indicators, and implementing continuous improvement frameworks across the organization. The Vice President Operations will partner closely with executive leadership, commercial, manufacturing, and technology teams to support Moderna’s growth, compliance, and customer experience goals while mentoring and developing high-performing operations teams. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Operations Management and Project Management skills to lead complex initiatives, streamline processes, and ensure consistent execution across multiple teams. Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with experience using data and metrics to guide operational improvements. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences. Advanced degree in Business, Operations, Engineering, or a related field preferred; bachelor’s degree required. Familiarity with compliance, quality systems, and risk management in a regulated industry is highly beneficial.

Strong MS Excel skills; familiarity with Bloomberg; scripting skills (Python/VBA/SQL) are a plus. Strong attention to detail, excellent communication, ability to multi-task under pressure, and a collaborative mindset. Excellent communication skills in both English and Chinese (spoken and written)

review_candidates.description: Job Description At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us. Job Description Boeing Global Services (BGS) is seeking a Quality Production Specialist to support our F-15 Qatar Program at Al Udeid AB, Qatar . Position Responsibilities: Reviews proposals, contracts, regulatory, program and customer requirements ensuring early quality involvement in program development. Prepares and maintains Quality directives, policies, processes, procedures and metrics to assure program, contract, customer, regulatory requirements, international standards and working agreements are deployed. Analyzes process data, metrics, models and flows to identify root cause of problems. Participates with stakeholders to develop potential preventive or corrective actions and implementation. Conducts research, compiles and analyzes performance reports and process control statistics, to continuously improve process capability. Conducts quality source selection and process reviews of suppliers' ability to meet program quality requirements and support business decisions and develops a coordinated response for management review and approval. Conducts hardware, software and system level audits to determine compliance with quality management system standards, configuration assurance, related business, regulatory and customer requirements and reports results to management. Analyzes data to provide material review dispositions for nonconforming materials, parts and equipment. Works under general direction. This position requires the ability to obtain the US Security Clearance from the US Government. This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work on-site. Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience): Experience working with F-15 or comparable fighter aircraft. 3+ years of experience with quality or inspection on military aircraft. 3+ years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS). Must be willing to work variable shifts, including weekends and overtime. Some positions may also be rotating shifts. Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience): 5+ years of experience with quality or inspection on military aircraft. 5+ years of experience in Quality Management Systems (QMS). Experience on F-15 platform. F-15 platform weapons experience. Previous Quality Assurance experience. Root cause analysis experience. The Boeing benefits package goes above and beyond, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer: Competitive salary and annual incentive plans. Continuous learning - you’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. Success as defined by you - we’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. Inclusive culture - you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. Learning Together Programme to support your on-going personal and career development. Access to Boeing’s Well Being Programs, tool and incentives. Important information regarding this requisition: This vacancy is for an international, locally hired position in Al Udeid, Qatar. Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S.-based payroll, and will commensurate with experience and qualifications and in accordance with applicable local law. Employment is subject to the candidates’ ability to satisfy all labor and immigration formalities. Applications for this position will be accepted until Sept. 21, 2026 Export Control Requirements: If the successful candidate is not a “U.S. Person” (as defined by 22 C.F.R. 120.62 “U.S. Person” includes U.S. citizens and U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents, refugees, or asylees) and the position requires access to export-controlled data, an appropriate export authorization by the U.S. Government may be required prior to such access. Employment, and the continuity of employment of non-U.S. persons, is contingent upon the company’s ability to secure and maintain the necessary export control authorization. Export Control Details: US based job, US Person not required Relocation This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility. Security Clearance This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. An interim U.S. Secret Clearance Pre-Start and final U.S. Secret Clearance Post-Start is required. Visa Sponsorship Employer willing to sponsor applicants for employment visa status. Shift Shift Worker (Qatar) Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not accept unlawful discrimination in our recruitment or employment practices on any grounds including but not limited to; race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military and veteran status, or other characteristics covered by applicable law. We have teams in more than 65 countries, and each person plays a role in helping us become one of the world’s most innovative, diverse and inclusive companies. We are proud members of the Valuable 500 and welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. Applicants are encouraged to share with our recruitment team any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Accommodations may include but are not limited to: conducting interviews in accessible locations that accommodate mobility needs, encouraging candidates to bring and use any existing assistive technology such as screen readers and offering flexible interview formats such as virtual or phone interviews.
